note: vespera! / export_app! build files: the library, a binary, the cargo test harness and rust-analyzer get separate cache and sidecar files, so one build no longer prunes the include_str! file another still reads; the target directory is read off rustc's --out-dir (dependencies and a relative CARGO_TARGET_DIR agree with the parent; VESPERA_TARGET_DIR overrides it); openapi.json and exported specs never describe #[cfg(test)]-only routes or schemas, so every build writes the same file; one path spelled with different parameter names (/{id} vs /{user_id}) and docs_url / redoc_url / spec_url colliding with an app or merged route are compile errors; undeclared security schemes are checked without a generated document; an ambiguous merge path lists the exporting crates; stale rust-analyzer route / cron entries of renamed handlers are ignored; sibling symlinked route directories are scanned; cron jobs outside src/ get real module paths or a clear error; two #[derive(Multipart)] fields reading one multipart field are a compile error.
